verdict.rationale: INPI Portugal is a government industrial-property office that handles patent, trademark and design filings. User-built automations that can be versioned, reviewed and rolled back are outside this kind of product, so the story is a category error. Filing-level actions such as amending an application (docs-19) or withdrawing one (docs-30) concern legal filings, not automations, and do not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
